Synchronous: connect, generate, persist, disconnect, respond.\n108:- [Author eval cases from a document](https://docs.mcpjam.com/
api-reference/eval-runs/author-eval-cases-from-a-document.md): The sibling of `cases/generate`: generation invents cases from the
suite's tools, import reads them out of something a person already wrote: a test plan, a spreadsheet of scenarios, a JSON export.
MCPJam's own model turns the document into full cases (ordered steps, tool calls, assertions), so the c…\n109:- [Read an eval auth
oring job](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/read-an-eval-authoring-job.md): Progress and drafts for a job started b
y `cases/generate` or `cases/import`. Poll this after a `202`, then commit the job once its `status` is `completed`.\n110:- [Write
a finished authoring job's cases into the suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/write-a-finished-authoring-jobs-
cases-into-the-suite.md): Writes the job's drafts into the suite. A draft carrying unresolved blocking issues or proposed addition
s is **skipped** rather than written, and comes back under `skipped` with a `reviewUrl` for finishing it in the app.\n111:- [Get o
ne eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-eval-case.md): A case that belongs to this suite and project
. A case in another suite is a 404, not a 403.\n112:- [Delete an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/delete
-an-eval-case.md): Removes the case from the suite. Past runs that executed it are not affected.\n113:- [Update an eval case](http
s://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/update-an-eval-case.md): Partial update: omitted fields are left as they are. Supplyin
g `steps` REPLACES the case's definition rather than merging into it. `matchOptions` and `checks` accept `null` to clear the case-
level override and fall back to the suite's.\n114:- [Upload a run artifact](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/upload
-a-run-artifact.md): Stores one artifact referenced by an ingested run (typically widget HTML too large to send inline) and return
s the `storageId` the run's results then reference. This is what `reportEvalResults` in `@mcpjam/sdk` uses for widget evidence.\n1
15:- [Get an upload URL for a run artifact](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-an-upload-url-for-a-run-artifact.m
d): Retired. Every request answers `410 Gone` with `code: \"FEATURE_NOT_SUPPORTED\"` and `details.code: \"SDK_UPGRADE_REQUIRED\"`.
`@mcpjam/sdk` 8.17.0 and later upload a run artifact by sending its bytes to `POST /projects/{projectId}/eval-ingest/artifacts`,
which returns the `storageId` the run's results…\n116:- [Discover authenticated eval ingestion capabilities](https://docs.mcpjam.c
om/api-reference/eval-runs/discover-authenticated-eval-ingestion-capabilities.md): Discover authenticated eval ingestion capabilit
ies. Uses the SDK reporting transport and the same tenant/project authorization as eval ingestion. Unsupported capabilities remain
absent.\n117:- [Persist advisory case-run evaluations](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/persist-advisory-case-run-
evaluations.md): Persist advisory case-run evaluations. Uses the SDK reporting transport and the same tenant/project authorization
as eval ingestion. Unsupported capabilities remain absent.\n118:- [Ingest a completed eval run in one call](https://docs.mcpjam.c
om/api-reference/eval-runs/ingest-a-completed-eval-run-in-one-call.md): The whole-run variant: submit a finished run and its itera
tions in a single request. This is what the SDK reporter uses by default.\n119:- [Mint a model lease for MCPJam-hosted inference](
https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/mint-a-model-lease-for-mcpjam-hosted-inference.md): How an SDK eval running OUTSID
E the platform (local dev, CI) uses MCPJam-hosted inference on the organization's credits, with no provider key of its own. Authen
ticate like any other `/api/v1` route (typically an `sk_` key).\n120:- [Revoke a model lease](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-referenc
e/eval-runs/revoke-a-model-lease.md): Kills this caller's SDK model leases under `runId` in the addressed project, immediately: th
e proxy fails a revoked lease closed from that moment. Leases also expire on their own, so this is for ending a run early (an SDK
suite calls it at teardown) rather than something a caller must do.\n121:- [Close an open ingestion run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/a
pi-reference/eval-runs/close-an-open-ingestion-run.md): Marks the run complete and computes its rollups. Until this is called the
run stays open in the dashboard.\n122:- [Append iterations to an open run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/append-
iterations-to-an-open-run.md): Appends one batch of iteration results to a run opened by `runs/start`.\n123:- [Authenticate and re
cord an eval start](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/authenticate-and-record-an-eval-start.md): Called by official
SDK, CLI and Vitest runners before executing an eval. Requires an organization API key or saved-login bearer. Records only start m
etadata, creates no dashboard run, and applies no debit or quota draw. Planned iterations are intent, not completed usage. Reuse t
he runStartId for ret…\n124:- [Open a run for incremental ingestion](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/open-a-run-fo
r-incremental-ingestion.md): Opens a run that iterations are appended to, for a long CI job that reports as it goes. Pair with `ru
ns/iterations` and `runs/finalize`.\n125:- [Get a run's gate waiver](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-a-runs-ga
te-waiver.md): The waiver in force over this run, or `null`. Available to anyone who can VIEW the run, not only to those who can g
rant one: a waiver its readers cannot see is not a visible waiver.\n126:- [Waive a run gate](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference
/eval-runs/waive-a-run-gate.md): Override a FAILING run's release gate until an expiry you name. This does NOT make the run pass:
the run keeps its `result`, the waiver is a separate audited record, and every surface that honors it, such as the CLI's `eval gat
e`, reports the gate as waived, by whom, why, and until when.\n127:- [Revoke a gate waiver](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/
eval-runs/revoke-a-gate-waiver.md): End a waiver early, putting the gate back. Requires the manage tier.\n128:- [Preview determini
stic draft evaluators against stored evidence](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/preview-deterministic-draft-evaluat
ors-against-stored-evidence.md): Requires suite configuration permission and a terminal run. Reserves a 60-second deterministic-pr
eview cooldown, independent of judge previews. Supply the returned continuation object with the unchanged draft to read the next b
ounded population. Reads at most 100 iterations within a 30-second operat…\n130:- [Get the authenticated account](https://docs.mcp
jam.com/api-reference/catalog/get-the-authenticated-account.md): The user behind the API key (keys act as their creator, scoped to
one organization).\n131:- [Read the organization's spend budget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/read-the-organizat
ions-spend-budget.md): The ceiling on what this organization may spend on MCPJam-billed work (chat, evals, judges and computer tim
e) in the current billing window, and how much of it has been spent.\n134:- [List organizations](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refer
ence/catalog/list-organizations.md): The organizations the caller belongs to: the source of the `organizationId` that `GET /projec
ts` filters by and `POST /projects` accepts. An API key is bound to one organization and only ever sees that one. Read-only: organ
ization, member, role and billing changes are not part of the public API.\n137:- [List a project's eval suites](https://docs.mcpja
m.com/api-reference/catalog/list-a-projects-eval-suites.md): Eval suites in the project with latest-run summaries and pass-rate tr
ends: the `suiteId`s the eval-run routes take.\n144:- [Delete a client](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/delete-a-cli
ent.md): Permanently deletes the client. Refused while a live environment, an active legacy goal or an eval suite still holds it:
the error names what to detach first. Guest callers are denied (a write).\n167:- [List a suite's settings history](https://docs.mc
